intro: More than a dressing table, the Aero is your personal styling haven. A sleek mirror, hidden storage, & a built-in socket make your routine seamless, while the dark finish adds warmth to your space.

features.title: A mirror that makes a statement
features.text: Step in front of the tall, sleek mirror that not only enhances your space but ensures you look and feel your best before stepping out.

features.title: Storage that works for you
features.text: Hidden compartments and bangle holders keep your essentials tucked away yet always within reach, so your space stays clutter-free and calming.

features.title: Bangle rods for effortless organisation
features.text: Thoughtfully placed bangle rods ensure your jewellery stays tangle-free, accessible, and beautifully displayed.

features.title: A pouffe designed for comfort
features.text: The stylish pouffe fits neatly under the table, giving you a comfortable place to sit while getting ready—because your routine should feel effortless.

features.title: Easy styling, no hassle
features.text: With a built-in electric point, your hairdryer, straightener, or grooming tools are always ready to go. No more struggling with awkward plugs.

features.title: Timeless elegance in Valigny Oak
features.text: The rich, sophisticated oak finish blends beautifully into any space, adding a touch of warmth and refinement to your everyday routine.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
